answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This matters because the cost of running many aliases grows faster than the influence they can exert, making the attack economically self-defeating. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a nebula as the anchor of the cost.
